title_en: Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Issues concerning the Trial of Criminal Cases of Ticket Scalping

articles.content_en: Article 1 The act of scalping tickets at high prices or through disguised price increases, or scalping seat, sleeper reservation numbers and ticket ordering vouchers, where the face value amount is 5,000 yuan or more, or the illegal profit amount is 2,000 yuan or more, shall constitute the “serious circumstances of scalping tickets” as provided in paragraph 2 of Article 227 of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China.

Article 2 For railway employees who scalp tickets or collude with others to scalp tickets; ringleaders who organize ticket scalping; and those who have previously received public security penalties for ticket scalping twice or more, or have been subjected to re-education through labor once or more, and have scalped tickets again within two years, and thus constitute the crime of scalping tickets, a severe punishment shall be imposed according to law.
